title: the tree of the processes survives a vanished process: the scan goes on at a stat file that is gone
intent: The wave repairs the second of the three places that the survey of the class of the defect named on 2026-11-21 (the first is the wave 101, the third is the wave 103).  The tree of the processes is read in the shell, in `scripts/lib/tree.sh`, and the three scripts that own a tree of processes read it (`scripts/dev-timeout:56`, `scripts/live-pilot:85`, `scripts/gate:98`).  The scan of the tree was one awk over the glob `/proc/[0-9]*/stat`, and awk stops at a file it cannot open: one process that exited in the middle of the scan cut the list of the descendants short, and `stop_tree` killed the part of the tree it was given and left the rest of it behind -- a server that is still running after the runner has stopped it.  The message of awk was hidden (`2>/dev/null`) and the list was cut all the same.  The second defect is in the same code: the fields of the stat file were read after the FIRST closing parenthesis (`index($0, ")")`), so a process whose name holds a parenthesis was read as a process whose parent is a letter, and its children were not found; the comment of the file promised the last parenthesis, and the code read the first.  The third defect is the blindness: the answer of awk on a file it cannot open is the same as on a file it cannot read, so the two things were one thing.  The repair is a scan that decides: it reads the stat file of every process of the tree and goes on at the file that is gone (a process that exited is not an error and is not complained about), it names the file that is there and holds no line (the reader does not know and says so), it reads the fields after the last closing parenthesis, and it reads the tree once and not once per level of it.  The proof of the repair is a new check of 343 lines with eight stands, and the stands are made against a tree of fake stat files that the check builds itself: the root of the tree is the variable `PROC_ROOT`, so the scan can be given a tree of its own and the defect can be reproduced deterministically instead of waited for.
objection: The wave repairs a reader in the shell and not a feature, and the price is named.  (a) **The repair does not hide the failure of the read**: the file that is gone is a process that exited -- it is not an error and it is not complained about -- and the file that is there and holds no line is another thing and is named, because the reader does not know and says so; a scan that treats every unreadable file as a gone process is a scan that is blind, and the stand 4 of the check proves that it is not blind.  (b) **The repair does not change the answer for a process that is gone**: the group of a process that is gone is still nothing, and that is the behaviour the briefing forbade to change.  (c) **The repair did not weaken the tree**: the group of the shell that reads the tree is never signalled (a mistake there would kill the gate that runs the check), the group of a process that leads a group of its own is signalled, and the descendants are the deepest first.  (d) **The old code could not be given a tree of its own**, and that is why the first stand of the check refuses the old code with the words 'the scan of the tree of the processes did not read the root it was given': the defect and the absence of the seam are two different things, and the check names both.  (e) **The class of the defect is not closed**: this wave closes the second of the three places that the survey named; the survey counted 42 places of the class and named 19 of them dangerous, and the rest of them are named in the waves 100 and 101.  (f) **One check of the diagrams was not measured**: the pipeline of the diagrams ran longer than 120 seconds and was stopped with the answer 3 (unknown), and the same happened on the unmodified `main` -- the host was under a load of about twenty on four CPUs, and the run is named here instead of being counted as a success.
refuted_by: the scan of the tree of the processes stops at a stat file that is gone, or the list of the descendants is cut short by a process that exited while the tree was read, or a stat file that is there and holds no line is not named, or a stat file that is gone is complained about, or the fields of the stat file are read after the first closing parenthesis, or a process whose name holds a parenthesis is not found by its parent, or the group of a process whose name holds a parenthesis is not the group of the process, or the group of a process that is gone is not nothing, or the descendants of a process are not the deepest first, or the group of the shell that reads the tree is signalled, or the group of a process that leads a group of its own is not signalled, or the scan reads a root that is not the one it was given, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The wave is the second of the three that close the class of the defect that the survey of 2026-11-21 found, and it is the only one of them that repairs a reader written in the shell.  (1) **The defect was measured, not guessed**: the old awk over the glob of the stat files was run against a fixture of four stat files, the third of them a dangling link; the child before the file that was gone was printed, the child after it was **lost**, and the answer of awk was 2 -- without `2>/dev/null` the message was 'fatal: cannot open file'.  The pid of the old awk was `parts[3]` of the path, and that is the pid only when the root is exactly `/proc`: with a root of three levels the old code printed the name of the directory of the fixture as the pid (measured: `pid seen by the old code: w102old3-3168`).  (2) **The repair is in one place**: `scripts/lib/tree.sh` grew from 81 lines and 2 947 bytes to 205 lines and 6 942 bytes; the knowledge of `/proc` still lives there, and the copy of it in three scripts did not grow.  (3) **The proof holds eight stands and can fail by each of them**; the bite of the control of the claim was measured by the writer on a copy of the tree (the mutation `|| continue` into `|| break`) and by the parent on a copy of the tree (2026-11-21): three controls, 0 failures -- the honest tree passes (C102a), the old code does not pass and names the root it did not read (C102b), and the scan that stops at the file that is gone does not pass and names the file that is gone (C102c).  (4) **Two more mutations of the writer** measured the same proof from the other side: the fields read after the first parenthesis and the naming of the file that holds no line -- each of them refuses with the words of the defect.  (5) **The claim of the wave is new** (`the-tree-of-the-processes-survives-a-vanished-process') and it amends no claim of the package; the writer proposed two more claims out of the same check (the fields after the last parenthesis and the naming of the file that holds no line) and they are not registered: a claim that is not asked for is not a claim, and the falsifier of this one names both anyway.
